---
name: Defect in the standard
about: Something in the standard is wrong, inconsistent, or missing a relationship the model needs
labels: defect
---

**Where.** Document and section or field name.

**What is wrong.**

**Source.** If this is a mismatch against the inherited OPIN material, cite the sheet or the
schema. If it is an internal inconsistency, cite both places that disagree.

**What it costs an implementer.** What breaks, or what has to be worked around.

**Does fixing it break the wire?** If correcting this changes a field name, an enum value or a
type, say so. It does not make the report less welcome; it decides which version the fix lands in.
